notes:
Three rungs out of five bullets. Bullet 1 is not a step: it is the op's availability condition -- Beaucedine Glacier (S), Xarcabard (S), Castle Zvahl Baileys (S) and Castle Zvahl Keep (S) must all be under Allied control, and Throne Room (S) need not be. That is server-wide campaign state the addon cannot see, so it is recorded here and nowhere else. Bullet 4 (an armory crate appears once the Shadow Lord falls) is an outcome, not something you do. The op ENDS BACK AT THE GIVER: bullet 5 says 'Speak with Rasdinice to complete this mission', so the ladder does not stop on the kill. The wiki writes the boss as [[Shadow Lord (S)|Shadow Lord]] -- the (S) is wiki disambiguation, the displayed and in-game name is Shadow Lord, which is what the mob row carries. Campaign Rank on this page is 'Medal of Altana' at four stars (the star glyph is corrupt in the cached wikitext and renders as four section signs); campaign rank is a real gate on signing up for the op and there is no schema field for it, so it lives in this note and in review_flags -- it is emphatically NOT gates.level, which carries the header's own 'Level: 75+' character-level gate. Header Time is 30 Minutes and nothing on the page contradicts it. Note the sibling Fiat Lux (B) numbers its bullets 1-4 rather than 2-5, because the availability note is a bullet here and plain prose there; the bullet numbers cited below are this page's. start.raw concatenates the Campaign Header's NPC Name / Zone / pos fields -- the template has no single Start field.

notes:
This op is not a ladder of places, it is 'earn 5000 EXP in Campaign Battles somewhere in the Northlands, then report back'. The only numbered bullets on the page are the five eligible zones; the sentence that states the 5000 EXP threshold and the sentence 'Return to Rasdinice to complete the Op' are unnumbered prose that the renderer indents under bullet 5, which is why the return step below cites [5] -- there is no bullet number of its own to cite. ZONE NAME NORMALISED: the page's fourth eligible zone is written 'Zvahl Keep (S)', which does not resolve (I probed it through tools/pipeline/resolve.lua and it returns no id); the resolvable form is 'Castle Zvahl Keep (S)' (id 155), which is what the Fiat Lux (S) and Bailey Borer (S) pages in this same batch use for the same zone. I recorded the resolvable form and am saying so here rather than shipping a rung that can never draw. Modelled the five zones as one group: strictly the group type means an unordered AND and this is an OR, so the note on every rung says only one is needed -- five markers that all draw at once is right for 'battle in any of these', a single arbitrary zone would have been a guess. Unlike its siblings Smokescreen I-III, this page has NO 'sign up with Rasdinice' bullet, so no opening talk rung was invented; the giver is carried in start. Campaign Rank is 'Starlight Medal' at one star (glyph corrupt in the cached wikitext) -- a real sign-up gate with no schema field, noted and flagged, deliberately not put in gates.level (header Level is 'Any'). Header Time is 'None' -- no time limit on this op. start.raw concatenates NPC Name / Zone / pos.

Bullet 3 (the 30-minute battle cap) is the BC timer restating the header's 'Time: 30 min in BC' and is not a step. Bullet 4, exiting via the Twilight Aureole, IS a step: campaign-ops battlefields do not credit you unless you leave through the aureole. The header carries a Unit Requirement of 1-6 members, which has no schema field; flagged. notes: Five bullets, three rungs. Bullets 2 and 3 merge into one fight rung -- travel to Castle Zvahl Baileys (S) and kill one Shadowguard Demon there. Unlike its Bailey Borer neighbour in this batch, this op offers NO choice of zone, and the 'After the walkthrough: Notes' section (whose bullets restart at [1]) is unusually load-bearing for a Notes section: it says killing a Shadowguard Demon in Castle Zvahl Keep (S) will NOT work, and that the two to use are in Castle Zvahl Baileys (S) near the entrance to the Keep. That is a correction to the obvious misreading, so it is on the step. The sub-bullet under bullet 3 ('Take Survival Guide to Castle Zvahl Baileys (S), walk through Dark Spark gate') is travel advice, not a rung. Bullet 4 is the return-to-giver hand-in; bullet 5 ('Kinslayer: Keep (B) becomes active in Offensive operations once you complete this Campaign Op') is an OUTCOME, not a step -- it is also the source for the gates.prev I wrote on the Kinslayer: Keep (B) record in this same batch, since that page does not state its own prerequisite. Campaign Rank is 'Moonlight Medals' at two stars (the star glyph is corrupt in the cached wikitext and renders as two section signs) -- a real sign-up gate with no schema field, noted and flagged here rather than forced into gates.level, which stays null because the header's Level is 'Any'. Header Time is empty; no time limit is stated. start.raw concatenates NPC Name / Zone / pos.

notes: Four bullets, three rungs, and the page is thin -- its Notes section is empty and one of its Rewards lines is blank. Bullets 2 and 3 merge into one fight rung: travel to Castle Zvahl Keep (S) and kill one of the four Shadowguard Demon there. THE ZONE IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE between this op and Kinslayer: Baileys (B): that page requires the Baileys and its Notes explicitly say a Keep kill does not count; this one requires the Keep. The titles rhyme, the zones are opposites, and nothing was copied across. This page also says 'one of the four' where the Baileys page says only 'one of the' -- the requirement is still a single kill, and the four is the population, so the mob count is 1. Bullet 4 is the return-to-giver hand-in. gates.prev IS NOT FROM THIS PAGE: this page states no prerequisite at all, but Kinslayer: Baileys (B) (page 146321, mission/campaign/177, in this same batch) says in its bullet 5 that 'Kinslayer: Keep (B) becomes active in Offensive operations once you complete this Campaign Op' and lists 'Access to Kinslayer: Keep (B) Campaign Op' among its rewards. That is a documented dependency and I recorded it, with the cat/area/id taken from that page's own front matter -- but it is the sibling's statement, not this page's, which is why the record is medium and flagged prev_from_sibling. Campaign Rank is 'Dawnlight Medal' at three stars (the star glyph is corrupt in the cached wikitext and renders as three section signs) -- one rank above the Baileys op's 'Moonlight Medals' at two, which is consistent with it being the follow-on. It is a real sign-up gate with no schema field, so it is noted and flagged and NOT written into gates.level, which stays null because the header's Level is 'Any'. Header Time is empty; no time limit is stated. start.raw concatenates NPC Name / Zone / pos.
